title: Mapped - Where UFOs have been spotted across Norfolk in recent years
excerpt: Norfolk’s skies have been the scene of a string of mysterious sightings in recent years, and we have mapped every recorded one since 2021.
content:
Norfolk’s skies have been the scene of a string of mysterious sightings in recent years, with people reporting everything from glowing orbs to strange star-like objects.

The UK UFO Database, a searchable archive of reported UFO and Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) sightings, contains a number of reports from across the county since 2021.

Created and run by Ash Ellis, the database allows people to explore sightings by location, year and the shape of the object reported, as well as read witness accounts.

Across the UK, it has recorded more than 2,000 reports in more than 981 locations over six years, with witnesses describing objects falling into 38 different shape categories.

Here is a map of every recorded sighting in Norfolk since 2021⬇️.

In Norfolk, some of the most commonly reported objects have been described as “orbs” or “star-like,” with six of each spotted over the county.

Other shapes include discs, spheres, triangles and cylinders.

Norwich appears to be the county’s main hotspot, with seven sightings recorded in and around the city since 2021.

Last year, it was named among the UK's UFO hotspots.

Places that have also seen reports of unidentified objects include Great Yarmouth, Hunstanton, and North Walsham.

The reports remain witness accounts of unexplained sightings and do not necessarily suggest an extra-terrestrial origin, with unidentified objects potentially having a range of explanations.
